title: VSB - Application Administrator: CAPEX reachable, commands and rows as canvas, refused writes shown
preconditions: Signed in to both apps with an account holding only the role "VSB - Application Administrator". A project in any business unit. Test project ids asked at run time.
test_data: PW-<runId> contract for the write attempt (deleted afterwards)
steps:
1. Run steps 2-n in the Canvas app first and note the result (reference).
2. Open DEVEX/CAPEX from the left rail, then by deep link (projectId) for an in-scope project.
3. Note every tab, toolbar control and grid menu command and whether it is visible and enabled.
4. Compare the grid rows and totals of one category with the reference.
5. On an in-scope project add a PW- contract, set a month paid, add a comment, then delete the contract.
6. Deep link to an out-of-scope project (if the role can open it) and try Add New Cost / Set as paid / Delete.
expected: The Cost app gates no screen or command on the role: App.OnStart builds gblCurrentUser (IsControllerOwnData, IsProjectDataAllCountries, EditableCounties, CanEditSelectedProject: false), but no CAPEX formula reads it. So the screen is reachable, the commands' visible/enabled state equals the canvas for the same user and project, and the rows equal the canvas rows (Dataverse business-unit scope decides what is read). A write outside the role's Dataverse scope is refused by Dataverse and the code app shows the refusal as an error message (D1: "server refuses, a 403 becomes a message"), never as a silent success or as "no rows"; a refused read shows "Cost data is unavailable".
acceptance: Screen reachable AND command visibility/enabled set = canvas set AND grid rows = canvas rows for that user AND in-scope writes persist (read-back) AND every out-of-scope write is refused with a visible error AND read-back unchanged.
canvas_ref: App.pa.yaml OnStart gblCurrentUser (App.pa.yaml:205); LeftNavigationMenu (App.pa.yaml:86-93); DevexCapexSummaryPCF.OnChange (Capex Costs Screen.pa.yaml:7278)
comments: Needs one real account per role (no mock roles). DataSourceInfo Create/Delete permission terms of the hidden command bar (Capex Costs Screen.pa.yaml:3161-3205) have no SDK equivalent (D1). | D90: no Cost screen or command reads the role, so the expected result is the same for every role. Run with the real account of the role if one exists; otherwise one run with a no-role account proves the refused write is shown, not silent.

1. Run steps 2-n in the Canvas app first and note the result (reference).
2. Open Add Cost from Table, change a month of one PW- contract and remove another PW- contract, Save.
3. Watch DEVEX/CAPEX for 20 s after it returns.
4. Reload.
expected: Canvas: Add Costs from Table navigates back and OnVisible reloads everything. Code app (CA-13, D51 §11.19): the cached book is patched with the saved changes before the panel closes; contracts and costs whose deferred deletes are pending are filtered out, so the grid never shows the pre-save values and the removed contract never comes back.
acceptance: From the first paint: edited month shows the new value AND removed contract absent for the whole 20 s AND after reload.

title: Leaving CAPEX while a write runs: the failure is still reported as a toast
preconditions: Same account signed in to the canvas Project Costs app and to the code app (pa app run or DEV). Test project (asked at run time) open on DEVEX/CAPEX (/costs/capex?projectId=…). A CAPEX category tab is selected with at least one sub-account that holds a non-standard contract with monthly costs.
steps:
1. Run steps 2-n in the Canvas app first and note the result (reference).
2. Start a save that will be refused (restricted account).
3. Immediately navigate to Contracts.
expected: Code app: toast "A change on the <screen> screen could not be saved." with the banner text as detail (NEW, CA-15). Canvas: the scrim prevents leaving.
acceptance: Toast shown on the Contracts screen.
comments: Needs a forced failure.

title: Cost Paid By change on Edit compares with the contract's stored or mapped payer
preconditions: Same account signed in to the canvas Project Costs app and to the code app (pa app run or DEV). Test project (asked at run time) open on DEVEX/CAPEX (/costs/capex?projectId=…). A CAPEX category tab is selected with at least one sub-account that holds a non-standard contract with monthly costs.
steps:
1. Run steps 2-n in the Canvas app first and note the result (reference).
2. Edit a contract whose Cost Type is blank and whose sub-account maps to SPV.
3. Leave Cost Paid By on SPV and Save; then switch to DevCo and Save.
expected: locInitialCostPaidBy = Coalesce(contract Cost Type, mapping 'DevCo/SPV'); no dialog when unchanged, the payer dialog when switched.
acceptance: Dialog only on the second save.
